resume: Generative Berlin School MIDI sequencer: voices that repeat, drift out of phase on loops of unequal length and develop their mutations over time. The FM-1 makes no sound itself: each voice goes out over USB on its own MIDI channel to your synths.

commandes.role: Undo: back up to the last 20 states.
Dice: new seed, applied at the next measure during playback.
Locks or unlocks the voice (voice key held, or the Voice page).
Rerolls all unlocked voices; with a voice key held, regenerates that voice.
Perform page. Held + SELECT: tempo, from any page.
Saves the project and the six slots; held + a slot key, stores the state in that slot.
Starts and stops. With internal sync, also sends MIDI Start, Stop and clock.
Part B; with a voice key held, an empty cycle for that voice.
Density from 0 to 100%: at the bottom, the whole ensemble thins out.
Picks the next voice of the model.
Changes the model (Demo trio, Full ensemble, Ambient drift); during playback, at the next measure.
Picks the mode: natural minor, Dorian, Phrygian, Mixolydian, Lydian, etc. The root is set on the Setup page.
F3 to B3: the seven voices (Pluck 1, Pluck 2, Bass, Pad, Lead, Drone, Heartbeat). A short press selects and mutes or unmutes the voice; a one-second press selects without muting.
C4 to B4: degrees 1 to 7, the harmony moves at the next measure.
C#4 to A#4: CC scenes 1 to 5, only those the model has.

gestes: Hold a button for one second (except PLAY): a card says what it does; releasing does nothing.
Hold a voice key, then EDIT, REC or SEL: the action applies to that voice.
SAVE held + C5 to F5: stores the state in slot 1 to 6; a simple press recalls it at the next measure.
OCT- and OCT+ held together for five seconds: update mode.
a_savoir: The FM-1 produces no sound: connect it over USB to a MIDI router and synths.
Projects are not exchanged between the Mac and the FM-1; the FM-1 starts built-in models from a seed.
